harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (4096-bit RSA, self-signed, 10-year validity) on node1, installed its certificate as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates, then restarted node1 and confirmed the CA trust and boot identity change both hold.
actions_performed: Confirmed node1 is Ubuntu 24.04 with openssl and update-ca-certificates available (cmd-5436aca49c7e4be9)

Generated CA key/cert with CN='OS Comparison Root CA' under /etc/ssl/os-comparison-root-ca, copied to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/, ran update-ca-certificates, verified with openssl verify (cmd-11c88c48cca0494d)
Captured baseline boot_id and re-confirmed CA trust before restart (cmd-b690fa30fb144a34)
Triggered 'shutdown -r now' on node1; acknowledgement returned as the connection dropped (cmd-904970f47f774585)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming reboot completed (cmd-237473ac582a434f failed as expected mid-reboot, cmd-5095f582d3df4864 succeeded)
Verified boot_id changed from 242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb to 6872186d-e0bf-43dd-ac17-b1655c6b456b, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified CA file presence, hash-dir symlink, and openssl verify success post-restart (cmd-f6d8392801e04a4b)

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: openssl req -x509 created rootCA.key/rootCA.crt; x509 -subject/-issuer/-dates confirms CN='OS Comparison Root CA', O='OS Comparison Lab', self-signed, valid 2026-2036

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied cert into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/, ran update-ca-certificates ('1 added, 0 removed'), and openssl verify against /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt returned OK
Captured baseline boot_id (242af11e...) and confirmed CA file present and trust verification OK prior to reboot
shutdown -r now issued via sudo -n with backgrounding so ack returned before disconnect; stream closed as node went down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving real restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart poll failed once (node still cycling) then succeeded with boot_id 6872186d-e0bf-43dd-ac17-b1655c6b456b, differing from baseline 242af11e-..., and new uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust state
evidence.summary: After reboot, CA file still present, hash-dir symlink to os-comparison-root-ca.pem intact, and openssl verify against system bundle still returns OK

attempts.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (4096-bit RSA, self-signed, 10-year validity) on node1, installed its certificate as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates, then restarted node1 and confirmed the CA trust and boot identity change both hold.
